definitions.explanation: The principles or reasoning behind something.
Used negatively to describe someone who argues too much or makes excuses.

examples.japanese: {理屈|りくつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧...。
{理屈|りくつ}⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{理屈|りくつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かっていて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Even though I understand it in theory, I can't easily put it into practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{理屈|りくつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think that reasoning is correct.

examples.japanese: {理屈|りくつ}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}っていないで→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧⟦やりなさい→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: Stop just making excuses and do it already.

notes:
{理屈|りくつ} can be neutral (logic, reasoning) or negative (excessive argumentation, excuses). Context determines the nuance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {理屈|りくつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to argue, to make excuses (often negative)
- {理屈|りくつ}⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧: argumentative, pedantic
- {理屈|りくつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to make sense, to be logical
- {理屈|りくつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: in theory (implying practice differs)
- {理屈|りくつ}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: without reasoning, intuitively

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{論理|ろんり}→論理：06026_ronri⟧: logic (formal, academic)
- ⟦{道理|どうり}→道理：10400_douri⟧: reason, principle (natural/moral reasoning)
- ⟦{屁理屈|へりくつ}→屁理屈：15530_herikutsu⟧: sophistry, quibbling (strongly negative)

USAGE:
When someone says {理屈|りくつ}⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧, it implies the person argues too much instead of taking action.
